t: These Site Convey Waterproof Safety Boots provide robust protection and comfort for trade professionals working on demanding construction sites or in wet outdoor environments. Engineered with a composite toe cap and a penetration-resistant composite midsole, these black metal-free boots offer lightweight defence against impact and sharp objects. The waterproof leather upper keeps feet dry while allowing breathability, and the innovative twist lock fastening system ensures a quick, secure, and precise fit. A dual-density polyurethane outsole delivers reliable slip resistance, while the wide-fit design, padded collar, and cushioned footbed provide all-day comfort during long shifts.
